02211101001222000211201 - ASI: 18

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  02 = 0 * 2
  11 = 1 * 1
  12 = 1 * 2
  20 = 2 * 0
  21 = 2 * 1
  220 = 2 * 20
  0021 = 00 * 21
  0100 = 01 * 00
  0221 = 02 * 21
  12220 = 12 * 220
  002112 = 0021 * 12
  110100 = 11 * 0100
  00211201 = 002112 * 01
  0221110100 = 0221 * 110100
  1222000211201 = 12220 * 00211201
  02211101001222000211201 = 0221110100 * 1222000211201
